items.question: How many days does the UAE Tawtheef hiring service take to deliver the documents to employers?
items.gold: Employers receive the deliverables within 8-12 days.

items.question: Can companies registered in free zones apply for the UAE Tawtheef hiring service?
items.gold: No, Tawtheef is offered only to companies registered with the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratization.
